sarmal.displayName: Sarmal: Plan & Guardrails for AI Agents
sarmal.description: Write your project's plan, structure and rules in .sar files. Sarmal checks the plan against the disk on every save and serves the same truth to your AI agents over MCP.
untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode Sarmal only recognizes and colors .sar files; validation and the Sarmal panels, which scan the disk and can start processes, turn on once you trust the folder.
semantic.phase: Faz — the time axis; a season or year ring
semantic.layer: Katman — the technology axis; a branch under a Blok
semantic.edge: edge field — the bağımlı and besler fields that form the dependency structure
config.language: Controls the language of Sarmal reading surfaces. Automatic selection follows the VS Code display language; .sar sources remain Turkish.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.validation: Live drift checks — underline syntax and rule diagnostics in red or yellow as you type. When disabled, only highlighting and reading mode remain.
config.inlineDiagnostics: Inline diagnostics: errors and warnings from the Problems panel also appear at the end of their line, colored by severity. When disabled, diagnostics remain available through underlines and the Problems panel.
config.activeEntityFocus: Focus the Problems panel on the active entity: only diagnostics from the project root containing the current file are shown. When disabled, all entities are listed and remain separated by their source label (Sarmal · _Project).
config.indentColors: Tint indentation levels with rainbow bands (red→violet, with a subtle glow); on by default. When disabled, every level gets a single soft violet tint that deepens slightly with each level. Applies only to .sar files.
config.glassEffect: Render type names (Adım · Katman · Blok) and keywords (görev: · kabul:) inside frosted-glass capsules. Applies only to .sar files.
config.liveMap: Live map: while the cone card is open, it refreshes to the node under the cursor without requiring a click.
config.miniGraph: Mini graph: draw the entire project in one graph below the roadmap; Faz, Blok, Katman, AltKatman and Adım stay on their own tracks with dependency links between them. Selecting a roadmap node marks it without narrowing the graph; selecting a graph node opens its definition. Disabling this setting hides the view completely.
config.miniGraphView: Mini graph view: classic (glass-lens rails), tree (one node per row, default) or progress (one card per Katman).
config.treeGuides: Tree guides — depth-colored vertical lines connect every widget to its closing edge, with a ghost label at the close (‹ Blok BLK-X).
command.writeAppreciation: 💛 Write appreciation (a heart note for the team)
command.openApprovals: Open the Approvals panel (gates awaiting a decision)
command.approve: Approve — the decision is made in the Approvals panel
command.approveWithNote: Approve with note — the decision is made in the Approvals panel
command.reject: Reject — the decision is made in the Approvals panel
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Sarmal
walkthrough.description: Meet the declarative tree language in five steps: the language, live checks, reading mode, learning hints and formatting.
walkthrough.language.title: Everything is a widget
walkthrough.language.description:
Sarmal describes folder and file hierarchy as a declarative tree: root→trunk→branch→leaf→fruit.
Opening a file with the ``.sar`` extension activates the language automatically.
walkthrough.validation.title: Live checks against drift
walkthrough.validation.description:
Errors are underlined as you type and the lightbulb suggests the correct fix.
You can disable this in settings: [Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22sarmal.denetim%22)
walkthrough.reading.title: Reading mode — code ↔ book
walkthrough.reading.description:
The eye icon in the title bar or ⇧⌘V turns the current tab into reading mode: prose becomes a book page, code becomes a colored block and figures gain frames.
[Try Reading Mode](command:sarmal.onizleme)
walkthrough.learning.title: Learning mode — hover and learn
walkthrough.learning.description: Hover over any keyword, arrow or section label to read its rule and understand who benefits from it. The language teaches itself.
walkthrough.formatting.title: Formatter — orderly layout
walkthrough.formatting.description: ⇧⌥F applies the official format: indentation, alignment and boundary spacing. The rules carry the layout for you.
walkthrough.navigation.title: Identity navigation — jump from code to code
walkthrough.navigation.description:
F12 jumps to a definition, ⇧F12 lists every reference, F2 renames a code at every occurrence, and ⌘T finds a definition by code or name.
The `gezin` tool exposes the same precise, single-call navigation to automation.
viewsWelcome.restricted:
Because this folder is not trusted, Sarmal only recognizes and colors .sar files.
Validation is off because it scans the disk and can start processes, so no Sarmal diagnostics appear in the Problems panel and the Sarmal panels do not open.
As soon as you trust the folder, validation and the panels turn on without reloading the window.
[Trust Folder](command:workbench.trust.manage)
